caption:
Google is folding Local Services Ads into Google Ads.

Home service categories are moving from the standalone LSA dashboard into Performance Max pay-per-lead campaigns this year: plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, cleaning, pest control.

Two moves to make this week:

1. Export your historical LSA reports. Past spend and performance data does not transfer on its own.
2. Check how you mark leads won or lost. Performance Max bidding runs on the outcomes you feed back to Google. Messy tracking teaches the algorithm the wrong lesson and your cost per lead climbs.

The shops whose CRM ties every lead to a real dollar amount are the ones this update rewards.

See every lead tracked to the revenue it produces.
